title: Chandler Estate w/ Pool/Pickleball/Putting Green!
description:
Experience the ultimate family retreat in Chandler, located near golf courses, tennis courts, and just a mile from Chandler Old Town.
• Enjoy the pool, hot tub, putting green, and pickleball court.
• Outdoor area features a full kitchen, grill, and pizza oven.
• Relax indoors with a gas fireplace, fully equipped kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, and board games.
A fitting spot for family gatherings and sports enthusiasts.

 The space 
Primary renter must be 25 years of age (proof of age required).

Kick Back, Relax, and Recharge in Chandler!

Located near golf courses, tennis courts, and just a mile from Chandler Old Town, this cozy single-level home in Chandler, AZ, is the ultimate family retreat. With easy, step-free access throughout, plus a sparkling pool, hot tub, putting green, pickleball court, and fire pit on the outdoor patio, you’ll be living in comfort and convenience. The pool can be heated upon request for an additional fee of $100 per night, with 72-hour advance notice required to arrange heating.

Inside, you’ll find a spacious living room complete with a gas fireplace — perfect for cozy evenings in. The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to whip up meals effortlessly, from the dishwasher and oven to the all-important coffee maker that’ll fuel your mornings.

Entertain to your heart’s delight in the 450 sq. ft. covered entertainment space, featuring a full kitchen, grill, ice maker, pizza oven, and TV. With seating for up to 14 guests around a huge patio table, it’s the ideal spot for meals, games, or simply relaxing with family and friends.

The bedrooms are designed for ultimate relaxation, featuring a king bed, queen bed, and twin bed, ensuring everyone gets a restful night’s sleep. Families with little ones will appreciate the high chair and stash of board games for endless fun!

The casita is the perfect little getaway for quiet time or catching up on work, complete with a desk and monitor, making it easy to stay productive or simply escape for a few moments of peace.

Whether you’re into golf, tennis, or simply unwinding with TV or high-speed Wi-Fi, this home has it all — fun, relaxation, and even a little work if needed — all in the heart of beautiful Chandler!

Please note: This listing is for the main home and casita.

Book your stay today and experience the perfect mix of relaxation and adventure!
